name: Grade 8 IT Practice: April Week 5 - Computing Systems
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: The physical parts of a computer or device.
words.example: The keyboard was hardware because the student could touch it.

words.definition: Programs that tell hardware what to do.
words.example: The browser software opened the portfolio webpage.

words.definition: A user action or typed value that a computer system uses.
words.example: Typing a keyword was input for the search engine.

words.definition: The result a computer system shows after processing input.
words.example: The search results were output from the system.

words.definition: The part that carries out instructions.
words.example: The processor carried out the instructions in the program.

words.definition: Short-term storage used while a computer works.
words.example: Memory held the open tabs while the computer was working.

words.definition: Long-term space for files and programs.
words.example: Storage kept the saved portfolio files after class.
The operating system managed the files, apps, and screen.
The drawing program helped the student edit the poster.
